set.body: From S10.1b (p0-s101 ba181a69). A share without images fails with 'Input <sha> is listed more than once' when two stimulus inputs have identical bytes, because a withheld input is listed by digest only. Real case: a duplicated stimulus file. List withheld inputs by (name, digest), and test with two identical images.
set.title: Bundle: sharing without images fails on identical stimulus bytes
